sloka: येन वित्रासिता लोकाः स देव असुर मानुषा ।अहम् सः रावणो नाम सीते रक्षो गण ईश्वरः ॥३-४७-२६॥
transliteration: yena vitrāsitā lokāḥ sa deva asura mānuṣā ।aham saḥ rāvaṇo nāma sīte rakṣo gaṇa īśvaraḥ ॥3-47-26॥

translations.english: O Sita I am called Ravana, the lord of demons by whom all the worlds of demons, snakes and gods are frightened.
